title: Understanding the DataFrame Structure
text: Look at how the data is organized in the second image. Notice that each $$player_{id}$$ is an index, and there are columns for each $$game_{type}$$. This structure is key to understanding which method was used.

title: Identifying the Method
text: Consider what method allows you to reshape data so that one column becomes the index and other columns are created for each unique value in another column. This is a common operation in data manipulation.

title: Choosing the Right Method
text: Which method allows you to create a new DataFrame with one column as the index and other columns for each unique value in another column?
